title: Tor of finitely presented DVR modules and cyclic power quotients
statement: Let A be a DVR with uniformizer π [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring] and P,Q finitely presented A-modules [def-sc-finitely-presented-module]. Tor_n(P,Q) [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules] vanishes for n≥2 and is finitely presented for every n. For positive r,s and n=0,1, Tor_n(A/(π^r),A/(π^s)) is isomorphic to A/(π^min(r,s)).

source.place: Section 00LY (Tor), Tag 00M3 (Tor symmetry), and Tag 00PD (DVR characterization)

proof.text: A finite free presentation of P has finitely generated kernel over the Noetherian PID A. The kernel is free as a submodule of a free module. Form its two-term projective resolution and tensor with Q. Its terms are finite, hence its homology is finite and finitely presented; all terms above degree one vanish.
For r≥s, resolve A/(π^r) by A --π^r--> A. Domain cancellation proves injectivity. Tensor with A/(π^s): the differential is zero, so homology in both degrees is exactly A/(π^s).
When r<s use the already proved symmetry of ordinary module Tor, exchange r,s, and apply the previous calculation. Empty presentations and the zero module are covered by the same argument.

proof_origin.place: Section 00LY (Tor), Tag 00M3 (Tor symmetry), and Tag 00PD (DVR characterization)

lean.statement: theorem dvr_scalar_tor {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A] (π : A) (hπ : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A = Ideal.span {π}) (P Q : ModuleCat.{u} A) [Module.FinitePresentation A P] [Module.FinitePresentation A Q] : (∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → IsZero (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} A) n).obj P).obj Q)) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, Module.FinitePresentation A (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} A) n).obj P).obj Q)) ∧ (∀ r s : ℕ, 1 ≤ r → 1 ≤ s → ∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ 1 → Nonempty ((((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} A) n).obj (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ Ideal.span {π ^ r}))).obj (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ Ideal.span {π ^ s}))) ≅ ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ Ideal.span {π ^ min r s})))
